Button fallback does not count as a passed wake test. The Heart choice is complete. Actual-device testing verifies clear audible delivery and usable conversation timing; it does not reopen voice selection.

human_action_policy.agent_responsibility: Build, configure, debug, migrate, test and prepare concrete reviewable outputs within existing authorization. Do not turn routine technical work into human chores.
human_action_policy.carry_forward: Reuse existing access, consent, decisions and valid evidence. Never request the same authorization again merely because another slice needs it.
human_action_policy.timing: Ask only when the action is needed; continue independent authorized work while waiting. A list entry is a future requirement, not an immediate request.
human_action_policy.conditional_actions: Apply a conditional item only when its condition is true. Record not_applicable with a specific reason when false; an agent may establish this from evidence without asking the user. Reassess the status when the trigger changes.
human_action_policy.completion: A slice cannot be done while an applicable slice_completion human action is unfinished. Paid-commitment, daily-reliance, clinical-use and release-gate items block only that named operation/gate, not unrelated free or supervised feature work.
human_action_policy.evidence: Done requires an actual completion reference and timestamp; record private or sanitized references, not names, credentials, clinical records or invented signoffs.
human_action_policy.roles: Human-action owner labels describe responsibilities, not application permissions. The application has exactly four roles: administrator, client, family/friend and clinician. One person may hold several responsibilities; the project owner is confirmed as both administrator and technical lead. Keep account identities private.

product_contract.navigation_policy: One master Talk to Nancy button is the primary client experience, available from home/My Day and all shipped client views. It opens one general conversation with only "Hi <preferred name>, what can I help with?", then listens. Show Starting/Preparing until audio begins, Speaking during playback and Listening only when taking the client's turn. Contextual suggestions follow the client's request, using current local time and authorized outstanding records; do not append an unsolicited agenda to the greeting. No workflow picker, task screen, meal screen or planning command is required first. The client can redirect at any time. Voice workflows execute the same typed commands without requiring navigation; visual views are optional support and remain directly accessible with independent buttons. Voice and buttons share a typed, role-authorized destination registry. My Day exposes the same saved tasks. Reject unknown or unauthorized destinations; navigation alone never accepts a plan or reports activity. Keep the active conversation/context available when changing views unless the client ends it or a genuine lifecycle condition closes it. October 19 client interface direction supersedes earlier manual client forms and broad navigation: five tabs only (Tasks, Meals, Groceries, Progress, Ask for Help); Nancy branding returns home, and FAQ/product-feedback buttons are separate. Client views are read-only; all care/product-feedback changes require reviewed voice commands. Removed client screens cannot be reopened through voice navigation. Staff roles retain their own authorized setup workflows. The default greeting remains short; explicitly selected Help/Suggestions entry may ask the corresponding brief opening question. October 19 implementation note: the simplified client does not mount the foreground wake control or listener; existing consent records are preserved without implicit activation. A future voice-first opt-in design must restore the applicable disclosure/state/stop behaviour before enabling it. October 19 Focus experiment: the ordinary URL remains Current. An exact opt-in review link and deployment presentation switch select Focus, with the same five tabs, voice state and care service. No persisted layout preference or random assignment. Preserve and verify an exact Current source/build restore point before editing. The first experiment is only a centered persistent Talk control and brief status; other research recommendations await review. Preserve the experiment/rollback without selecting it for clients. Future visual redesign needs an explicit owner decision. See docs/CURRENT_UI_DESIGN.md.

task_model.schedule_policy: Persist scheduled instants with participant time zone/local date and explicit unknowns; accepted versioned changes alone alter the schedule. Use the shared daily rhythm and fresh context in product_contract.daily_companion. Rank approaching commitments using actual reports, known duration, preparation/travel/rest and client-reported effort/energy. Never infer capacity from free time or stress from unfinished tasks. Prefer finishing discretionary tasks by the configured target; confirm exceptions. S02 corrections/reschedules preserve history. S04 adds explicit task sessions and consented focus checks under daily_companion.focus_policy; no monitoring is claimed before implementation/live qualification.
task_model.meal_policy: A planned meal has one shared task occurrence identity; acceptance is not eating and reporting cannot double-count it. Offer practical household choices, portions and alternatives within supplied preferences/approved constraints; confirm grocery additions. Distinguish full meals, snacks and unknown intake. The user examples of suppressing conflicting automatic full-meal suggestions within one hour and checking after six waking hours without a confirmed food report are configurable personal planning/check-in rules, not clinical thresholds or a prohibition on requested food. No report means unknown intake: ask before concluding a meal was missed. A late breakfast must not mechanically trigger lunch at the next clock boundary. Use actual occurrence time, reconcile late/corrected/voided reports and cross-midnight facts, avoid overnight false prompts, and recheck immediately before delivery. Reactive suggestions ship in S01/S02; scheduled intake checks require S04 consent and delivery qualification.

Atomically commit rejection, reason, one linked HelpRequest offered to other authorized family members and one scoped AdministratorFlag. Remove the request from the pending client inbox without assigning a task. Preserve the original request and reason history. No noncompliance label, achievement penalty or automatic reassignment to the client. An alternative helper must explicitly volunteer/accept; acknowledgement and resolution have visible states.
